scope: Theorem 1.2 of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let (X, B) be a projective lc pair of dimension four with rational boundary. No Q-factoriality or pseudo-effectivity is assumed. (i) Every negative extremal ray at every stage has the contraction and, when birational, a positive model required by Definition 1.1. (ii) Every program of Definition 1.1 starting from (X, B) has finitely many birational steps, for every sequence of permitted choices. (iii) Every maximal program ends either at a projective lc pair with nef adjoint, or at a Mori fibre space: a projective contraction with connected fibres, relative Picard number one, lower- dimensional normal base, and relatively ample negative adjoint. An already nef input has a zero-step completed program.
